6: If a man has sex with a pure woman and she says ‘I have become impure’ and he separates immediately he is liable for a punishment of Kares  because he derives the same pleasure coming out as when he went it (to the woman’s body).  What should he do? Dig his toenails in the ground and stay there without threshing until he loses his erection and separate when he no longer has an erection

Rema he should be filled with fear and dread about the sin that came to him (Beis Yosef in the name of the Smag)  He should not lean on her (body) he should lean on his hands and feet so he should not get any pleasure from her.  If he separates accidentally when he is hard, if he didn’t know that is was forbidden to separate from her, he should fast 40 days – they do not have to be consecutive, each week he can fast 2 days, for example Monday and Thursday, and in the evening of the fast he is forbidden to drink wine or eat meat.  If he is not able to fast he should redeem himself by giving money to charity according to his wealth, if he is rich he should give more than if he is poor.  Be stringent in his repentance.  It is a merit to Repent a lot (Mahari Siman 60) The woman does not need atonement.  If they had sex not at the time of her expected menses (veset) and found blood after sex, even if it was found on his examination cloth, it is called ‘Ones’ (something that happened through no fault of their own) – they both do not need atonement, not him and not her (Mordechai and Rosh in the name of the Maharam)
